method_notes: No ATBD is linked from any NISAR collection; evidence comes from the linked Product Specifications, SIS documents, the VWC memo, ASF user guide pages and collection abstracts.
BETA products are linked to BETA inputs and PROVISIONAL to PROVISIONAL (same maturity).
PARENT rows have matching CHILD rows on the parent; RELATED rows are written in both directions. INPUT rows have no inverse in the vocabulary.
The processing-level progression check is applied to PARENT/CHILD rows only, as in the parent skill's Step 6.
